o.en: Statistics file to use, may be specified multiple times. By default all files in /proc/net/stat are scanned.

Display only keys specified. Each key k is of the form [file:]key. If <file> is given, the search for the given key is limited to that file. Otherwise the first file containing the searched key is used.
Specify display of subject/header. '0' means no header at all, '1' prints a header only at start of the program and '2' prints a header every 20 lines.
